learning_objective: The learner can manually inspect annotated data by sampling examples, self-annotating to compare with given labels, fact-checking responses, and identifying duplicate queries with conflicting responses to assess annotation trustworthiness.

common_misconceptions.description: Believing that data exploration tools can fully replace the need to manually stare at and inspect raw data.
Assuming that provided annotations are correct without verifying them by attempting to annotate the same examples yourself.
Thinking that all examples in a dataset are unique and not checking for the same query appearing with different responses.
